description:
Perform a mesh independence study on a wind turbine blade. 

1. Open QBlade and load the project '/home/ga/Documents/projects/start_turbine.wpa'.
2. Run a BEM simulation on the existing (coarse) rotor at Wind Speed=10m/s, TSR=7, Pitch=0. Note the Power Coefficient (Cp).
3. Navigate to the HAWT Blade Design module and refine the blade discretization to at least 50 sections (using 'Refine/Redistribute' or similar tools).
4. Run the BEM simulation again on the refined rotor with the same parameters (10m/s, TSR 7, Pitch 0).
5. Save the refined project as '/home/ga/Documents/projects/refined_turbine.wpa'.
6. Create a report file '/home/ga/Documents/projects/mesh_study_report.txt' listing the Baseline Cp and Refined Cp.
